balls.text: David picks the fielder and RCB finish on 222. But wait, Tim David has reviewed this for height! It's a full toss that David tries to flick away over square leg. One hand comes off the bat and the ball doesn't carry beyond the fielder. The check confirms it was a fair delivery and RCB do finish on 222
Another slot ball, another boundary. David thumps this down the ground, straight enough of long-off, and picks up four more. RCB cross 220
David's nailed that one! Arshdeep errs in line, and this attempted yorker on leg becomes a slot ball. David nonchalantly flicks it over deep midwicket, with the fielder watching it sail over
Nails the wide yorker but Venkatesh is able to dig it out through backward point
Short ball cramps David, who was early into the pull. The ball hits high up on the bat and lobs up towards deep midwicket but doesn't carry
Fires a full ball down leg as David gives charge
Arshdeep looks for the wide yorker, Venkatesh reaches out to try and squeeze it away. Manages to get it into the vacant midwicket region
Nails the wide yorker but Tim David still finds a boundary! Reaches out and drills it through backward point
Looks for another yorker outside off, Venkatesh this time goes inside out but can't get enough on it. Goes to deep cover on the bounce

Has he nicked it? Prabhsimran was convinced, but the umpire isn't. PBKS review Venkatesh reached out at a wide yorker angled across him. Ball went close to the toe end. Looks like the sound came from bat hitting the ground. Another review lost
Full ball angled across, and it stays a touch low does the pace-off delivery. Venkatesh was early into the shot and misses it
Short and closer to off, puleld to deep midwicket
Short ball wide of off, David slaps it away through backward point. The two fielders in the deep combine to prevent a boundary
Arshdeep nails the wide yorker now. Venkatesh can't touch it
In this kind of form, Venky is going to punish that all day long. Low full toss on leg and he just helps it along through the vacant fine leg region. 200 up for RCB
Very full around leg, worked down to long-on
Yep, that's what Tim David can do. Crash, bang, wallop. It's a length ball outside off and David takes a small step out and just gives it a mighty flat-batted whack over midwicket
In the blockhole just outside off, drilled to long-on
Length ball outside off angles into David, who looks to clip it leg side but gets it off the outside edge. Goes on the bounce to short third
Mighty hit, into the second tier! Overpitched on the stumps and Venkatesh clears his front foot and hammers it over long-on
Now Ferguson gets the yorker right. On the stumps, dug back out to the bowler

Slower bouncer on leg, Venkatesh can't connect on the ramp. And it's called wide for height. PBKS have reviewed the decision. Venkatesh was on his toes at the crease when the ball sailed over him. Looks like it was the right call. And ball-tracking confirms it. PBKS burn a review
Creamed through extra cover! Overpitched on the stumps at 140kph, and Venkatesh nails the grounded drive

What an imperious way to bring up your first fifty of the season! This is full outside leg and Venky shuffles leg side and lofts this 141kph delivery over long-off. He had a slow start, but my oh my has he turned things around
Looks for a leg-stump yorker, David is able to tuck it out to deep midwicket
Length ball on the pads, Venkatesh swings it away to deep midwicket on the bounce
Full on middle and angled across, Venkatesh eases it down to long-off
Venkatesh continues his onslaught! This is a bouncer wide of off. Venky again moves a long way across the stumps and this time scoops it over the keeper
Oh, that's cheeky from Venky! Shuffles across the stumps to this attempted wide yorker and paddles it past a diving short fine fielder
Punches a length ball down to mid-off
Length ball outside off, clipped away through midwicket
Short outside off, Venkatesh swats it out to deep point

Chahal has gone for runs but he gets a big, big wicket here. Full on leg and Kohli wants to take him on with the flick. Doesn't get it out of the middle and it goes straight to Priyansh Arya at deep midwicket
Looks to take on this full and wide delivery and ends up slicing it . The ball however doesn't reach deep point
Venky really finding a gear-shift here. Another slot ball punished by the RCB allrounder. Full on leg and Venky deposits it over long-on
Chahal slides a length ball across Venkatesh, who looked to punch it on the off side but misses out
Venkatesh goes big again! This is too full from Chahal and he heaves it over deep midwicket and deep into the stands
Floated full just outside off, Kohli hammers it along the surface to long-on

Kohli ends up chipping this full ball, and it doesn't reach long-on running in. This was flung full around leg and Kohli didn't get that as well as he'd have liked. Brar bowls out for impressive figures of 2 for 35
Tossed up full and wide, drilled out to the off-side sweeper
Drills this full ball out to long-off
Low full toss, whipped away to deep midwicket
Venky has picked this as the over to attack! This is overpitched and Venkatesh gets a stride forward and swings it away over midwicket for a one bounce four
Venkatesh on the charge! Dances down the track to this full ball and lofts it straight down the ground
Kohli finds the gap! He has to wait on this slower ball and he pulls it in front of square. Too far from the deep backward square fielder, and Kohli picks up another boundary
Back of length outside off, Venkatesh pulls it away to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, tucked through midwicket
Very full outside leg, whipped away to deep midwicket

Oh, poor fielding there. A theme that's troubled PBKS through the season. Lockie nearly nails the yorker and Venkatesh backs away and manages to drill it straight to mid-off. Should have been a simple stop for Arshdeep but it goes right through him and dribbles to the boundary
Full outside leg, Venky misses his flick and is hit on the pads
Short ball angled across, Venkatesh looks to swat it away. Goes to the keeper's left off the toe end of the bat and they steal a single
The crowd erupts as Kohli brings up his fourth fifty of the season. Full and wide, and he drills it to long-off's left
Gets the wide yorker right. Venkatesh is able to use his long reach to squeeze it down to long-off
Looks to go short and wide, Kohli manages to swat it along the ground to deep midwicket
Full outside off, Kohli reaches out and caresses a drive through the covers. Goes to the fielder in the deep and they easily pick up two
Kohli meets him with an imperious flick! It's full on middle, Kohli backs away and then whips it away over square leg, using those famed wrists of his to great effect
This time Venky does connect with the reverse-sweep! Floated full on middle and Venkatesh swats this flat over the cover cover fielder
Chahal slides a length ball across Venkatesh, who looks for the reverse-sweep but can't connect. Looks at the umpire for the wide signal but the umpire has nothing for him
Short-ish outside off, Kohli pulls it between deep midwicket and long-on
Looks to step out again. Wants to whip this through the leg side but misses it and gets a leading edge that luckily for the batter, goes over Chahal
Smart from Chahal. Sees Venkatesh advancing and pulls back the length. Venkatesh pushes at it and misses and the ball bounces back to Chahal off his thigh
On a length on the pads, Kohli goes back and whips it out to deep midwicket
What an impeccable spell from Brar, so far. Was on a length outside off, cut laaaate, down to backward point.
On a length outside off, spinning away from Venky once more. Driven straight to extra cover this time around
Venky times this well, but fielder nabs the ball near deep backward point. Was outside off and glided late
On a length at the stumps. Kohli on the backfoot and he flicks across the line, down to long-on
Back of a length at the stumps, spinning away to outside off. Driven past a vacant mid-off

Harpreet Brar, what a comeback into this side! Just smart spin bowling, really. Back of a length outside off, grips off the pitch at 95.7 kph. DDP too early into this cut and he bunts it right into cover's hands. DDP departs five short of his half-century
On a length outside off. Keeper collects and he throws this at the stumps, misses, gets it to ping off Kohli's bat instead

Haha, now some fun from Kohli here! Was cut down to Harpreet at point, who misfields this. Kohli stays outside his crease, tempting a throw to his end. But Harpreet doesn't go for the ploy. Kohli plays this late from outside off but can't find the gap
He's still not middling these, but when you've got those titanium wrists, how does it matter? Was on a length and rising at his hips, rolls his hands over this delivery and smashed down to long leg
On a length and drifting into the pads. DDP goes for a flick under his eyes, gets it down to deep midwicket
Runs down the pitch and bottom-edges this to the keeper! Was back of a length, 127 kph. DDP goes for a huge waft across the line but can't middle this one

Kohli thrashes this one down to deep extra cover. Straight to the fielder stationed at the ropes. He has struggled to time these shots as well as he usually does, lofts etc. Was on a length outside off and stuck in the crease once more

DDP pulls out of this slower 'un, a bouncer that just driiiifts past the batter. He lets this one go, expecting it to perhaps be a wide, and anyway too far away for him to throw his hands at. But umpire deems it's a legal delivery, on we go
And now another great flick from DDP! How he reaches for these deliveries so late, and right under him, is a marvel. Was back of a length outside off, cut down to deep backward point
On a length and moving away outside off. DDP crouches deep in his crease and cuts it down to deep point
Kohli goes for an aerial drive, mistimes it, but it dives safe... Full-ish at the stumps, sticks in the pitch once more, and it lands well in front of long-on
Back of a length and gliding past the off-stump line. 126.4 clicks. There to be hit, but sticks in the pitch and DDP mistimes a hoick across the line. Ball dribbles to square leg
Shashank into the attack with his rather effective dibbly-dobblies. He gets this in on a length, outside off. Kohli drives this down to mid-on with ease
And the over ends with 21 runs off it... Rifled in quicker, right in the slot at the stumps. DDP moves one foot out of the way and drills it across the line. Flies over long-on

Fuller and still outside off. Kohli drives this to deep extra cover and hits his bat on his pads, not quite happy with that shot. And guess what... Chahal's given away 15 runs already and now he has bowled a no-ball with this one, so he'll have to reload

Kohli on the backfoot, and Kohli pierces the gap between cow corner and deep midwicket. Ball was on a length and spinning away - just a little - from the off-stump line. Kohli times this to perfection
On a length and flicked down to deep midwicket
Kohli shifts into the leg side to reach this delivery while right under him. Driven down to long on
Misfield, another misfield from PBKS this season... Spinning off a good length and outside off, cut down to point, where the fielder lets it dribble away from his dive
Runs down the pitch and lofts this right over the bowler! Was on a good length at the stumps, DDP uses his long levers to send his former RCB colleague over the ropes here
And now he hops on one leg and scoots this down to deep midwicket. Was back of a length and DDP swipes across the line by getting under the ball

DDP, how do you do it... Absolutely fine ball by Arshdeep, right outside off on a length. DDP leans deeep in his crease and the ball is so close to his body, but he can still cut it so fine and so late, down to deep third
Another rapid ping off Kohli's bat... Was bounced in at his helmet, he gets inside the line of this and pulls it down to deep square leg
Back of a length outside off, swiped down to deep square leg
Speared in on a full-ish length outside off, Kohli drives it down to mid-off now

In the air and just past Connolly's dive at mid-wicket! Kohli goes for another huge whip across the line. Was full-ish and on the pads, there to be swiped at. He gets it past the fielder and it runs down to the empty ropes at deep midwicket
On a length outside off, pushed in slightly fuller and at 94 kph. Driven down to extra cover
On a length and spinning into DDP's pads once more, now flicked down to deep midwicket
On a length, at the pads. Kohli plays an assured flick down to deep square leg
DDP goes for a rather inelegant hoick across the line. Was on a length and spinning into him once more, DDP swings for the hills but mistimes it. Deep square leg runs in to cover this
Straighter and attacking the stumps. Defended off the good length and back to Brar
Way down leg side. Time to reload

All timing from Padikkal on this one... Brar hardly did anything wrong here. Was on a length and spinning back into the stumps. DDP stays deeeep in his crease, then cuts it behind point and to the ropes
Kohli mistimes a drive on the up. He's so good at playing those back of a length deliveries, rising at him from well outside off. But on this occasion, he can only get it right to mid-off
Back of a length and rising at DDP from outside leg. Defended towards square leg and an easy run to the other end
Another French cut, but thrashed right into his pads this time... Was outside off on a length, goes for a drive but gets the inside edge back into his pads
Ferguson strays into the leg side once more, gliding back into DDP's pads. He goes for a minimalist stroke and gets it down to deep fine leg, no pressure
Speared in down the leg side, past DDP's flick. Time to reload
Aah, risky but well-judged single. A mistimed drive past the bowler, down to mid-on, and Kohli scampers through to the other end

King Kohli, welcome to the crease. He's had a few sighters and now he uses those otherworldly wrists of his to flick this length ball off his pads, and over the deep midwicket ropes. Still head and all the power comes off those hips

Brar bowling like he's got a red ball in hand! Impeccable lines. Pushed in quite quicker once more. On a length outside off and spinning in just slightly, zooms past DDP's half-hearted attempt at a defense
Once again, he goes on the backfoot and can only cut it straight to covers, which is packed now
Now the cut, straight to covers. Was on a length and kept outside off, DDP couldn't place it past the covers cordon
Padikkal is a spin hitter par excellence, at least in 2026, and he's certainly taken the attack to Brar here. Was in the slot tbh, and Padikkal goes on front foot and lofts this over long-off

Chopped on, and Brar is absolutely pumped! His teammates swarm him, and why not. He pushed it just fuller, 96.3 kph and moved back into Bethell once more. He's cramped into the cut, because it spins back in more than he expected, and certainly quicker than he expected. Edged back into the stumps

Bethell shows us he's all class when he gets going... On the backfoot in a jiffy to this delivery, on a perfectly okay length and spinning away from the left-hander. He cuts this down to the deep square boundary with impeccable timing
Omarzai bowling good lines here. On a length and just moving in from outside off, glided late down to backward point once more

This time he middles it, and almost gets caught out by Arshdeep Singh at mid-on! Was full and closer to the off stump. Bethell goes for a good-looking drive but straight to Arshdeep, dipping and bursts through his hands. Not quite a drop...

Expansive French cut... Dribbles down to deep fine leg. Was pushed quite full and well outside off. Bethell went for a drive, a rather lazy extension with no foot movement. Takes the inside edge and shuffles behind him and down to the empty boundary
On a length outside off, Kohli stays back and glides this down to backward point
Eek, that one slips out of his hand. He'll have to reload

Kohli doesn't miss out this time, whaddashot! Didn't middle this but he leans into a huge lofted drive over deep extra cover. Pushed slightly fuller outside off, bat twists in his hand but Kohli has bunted this over the ropes anyway
Kohli is going for wafts away from his body but misses. He isn't expecting the swing here. On fifth stump on a good length, grips and swings away once more
Another assured Kohli flick, down to midwicket. Was on a length and rising at him in front of the stumps once more, but he got on top of the bounce on offer
Bethell flicks this down to square leg. Was on a length but drifting into the pads with the swing. Bethell stays deep in his crease and shovels this into the leg side
Thrashed right into his pads! Back of a length, rising at Kohli outside off. He goes for a huge pull but mistimes it into his front pad
Pitched fuller, moving away from Kohli once more. He defends it back to Arshdeep. Watchful start
Ooh, finds a leading edge! Was outside off and moving away. Kohli has a slight poke at it away from his body, runs down to backward point once more
On a length and swinging away. Bethell plays a late defense, glides it down to backward point, and takes off for the other end

Slower ball outside off, miscued to long-off and RCB become the first team to reach the playoffs in IPL 2026. A stellar batting display followed up by a stellar bowling show after losing the toss, and it's scenes of joy for the defending champions. PBKS, the losing finalists last year, slide to their sixth consecutive defeat, and are staring now at the very real probability of missing out on making the playoffs
Now he nails the yorker and Brar jams his bat down. Goes off the inside edge to his right. They get a single

That was good bowling, but a misfield means Rasikh concedes a boundary. Slower ball completely does Brar in, who is early into his massive swing. Outside edge takes it to short third's right and Suyash makes a meal of it
Rasikh with another bouncer and this time it's a legal delivery. Runs in from around the wicket and bumps it in outside off

This time Shashank chips it to long-on, and RCB can be assured of victory here. Rasikh goes full again and Shashank again wants to play that helicopter-like whip shot. Think he closes his bat face a tad bit early and gets a leading edge and it lobs up to Kohli
Now Rasikh slides one down leg

Bethell nearly grabs a screamer! Shashank whips this full ball around off in the gap at cow corner. Bethell runs to his left from deep midwicket and dives at full stretch, but just can't hold on. Would have been a worldie if it had stuck, but full points for the fielding effort. Saves a boundary
Bouncer outside off to start off with and this one is called wide for height

Oh, Jacob Bethell, stunning piece of fielding! Hazlewood errs, bowling a full toss outside off, Shashank whips it in front of square. Bethell runs to his left from deep midwicket and leaps high, grabs the ball and throws it back inside the boundary before landing outside the ropes. Saves five runs there! However, Shashank Singh has reviewed it for waist-high no-ball. Seems to have been fine but ball-tracking will tell us soon. And yeah, that's well before waist-height so the over is over
Hazlewood continues to bowl a superb over. Just a single, again. Yorker on leg and Omarzai can only dig it out to deep midwicket
Now Hazlewood bumps it in short at 143kph. Flies over the bat with Omarzai beaten by the pace

Oh, lucky boundary for Omarzai! But PBKS will take it. Omarzai skips out even as Hazlewood goes for the yorker on off. Omarzai swings at it and gets a thick edge that goes in the gap between backward point and short third

Oh, Hazlewood nails the length on his wide yorker, but not the line. Just wide of the tramline. Called wide. But Jitesh reviews the decision. The revised wide line is a bit wide of the tramline since Omarzai was standing outside off to start off with. And a chunk of the ball is seen to be inside the line, so it's an excellent review!
Hazlewood starts off with a length ball that Shashank can't connect on as he looks to play a pickup shot. Ball drops to his right and they sneak a leg bye
Cracking hit over extra cover! Omarzai dances down to this full ball and hammers it inside out. Hit flat, but it goes all the way
This time Bhuvneshwar nails the yorker. Shashank can only flick it away to deep midwicket
Low full toss outside off and Shashank takes full toll of it. Whips it away in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. Brings up a 22-ball half-century. Very good knock here from Shashank Singh
Now Shashank slashes at a short and wide delivery that' not called wide. Shashank consults his partner and opts not to review
Shashank nails the ramp again. Short outside off and Shashank, who has shuffled across, ramps it to a very fine deep third's right
Good yorker outside off, dug out to deep point
Looks for the yorker again and it turns into a full toss, grazes the pads and beats Jitesh's dive
Another yorker right on the money from Hazlewood! Omarzai looks to keep it out and inside edges it onto his left boot. The ball ricochets to his right and they pick up a run
Hazlewood nails the yorker and Shashank can only bring his bat down and hope to get something on it. Nutmegs himself and gets it to long leg
Full around middle and leg, swung away through square leg
Length ball angled across, blocked back towards the bowler

Oh boy what a way to get out at this stage! Stoinis misses a juicy full toss as he looks to whip it away. Hit plumb in front and the finger goes up immediately. Stoinis reviews it. No bat, confirmed by UltraEdge, and it's umpire's call on wickets with the ball projected to be just clipping leg stump. PBKS had built up great momentum over the last three overs, but this disrupts that. Hazlewood doing the damage, although this time not quite with a delivery he'd have thought would have done the trick
Gets the wide yorker right, and Stoinis can only dig it out to deep cover

Has Bhuvi got that inside the line? Goes for the wide yorker that Stoinis leaves alone. Stoinis immediately asks for the wide. Not given and PBKS review it. The wide line is revised since Stoinis was standing outside off when Bhuvneshwar bowled it. And the ball has stayed well within that line

In the gap and that's another boundary. Bhuvneshwar goes for another yorker on off, it's just a little short, and Stoinis whips it between long-on and deep midwicket. Tim David's dive is not enough and PBKS are mounting a comeback here!
Now Bhuvi does get the yorker right outside off. Shashank steers it to short third and they pick up a single
Out comes the helicopter! Or that's what it looked like anyway! In the slot outside off and Shashank uses quick hands and strong wrists to launch this over cow corner
Starts off with an attempted yorker that's driven wide of long-off by Shashank. They manage to get two
Stoinis finishes this over well! Looks for the yorker does Rasikh and ends up bowling a knee-high yorker and Stoinis whips it away in the gap through midwicket

Oh, if Kohli can't stop it there, I don't think anyone can! That's raced away. Rasikh went for that wide yorker, turns into a very low full toss, not much wrong from the bowler there. Stoinis manages to get bat on it this time and drills it well wide of long-off
Goes full and wide, Shashank shuffles across and slaps it away to deep cover
Now he nails the yorker on off. Stoinis can only clip it out to deep midwicket for a single
Nails this wide yorker, just inside the line! Stoinis can't get bat on it
Oh, he's lucky this doesn't carry! Looks to take on this full ball outside off and ends up slicing it. The ball lobs up with Krunal Pandya racing in from deep point, but Shashank gets away
Bouncer outside off, Shashank sways away. Called wide
Full on leg, clipped through midwicket for a single
Shashank adds salts to RCB's wounds. 108kph length ball outside off and he uses his fast hands to slap it away through backward point. Expertly finds the gap
Bethell shells it at deep midwicket This is flung full on off and Stoinis can't nail the slog sweep. goes flat to Bethell, and he can't hold on
Tucks this length ball into the midwicket region for a single
Oh, a ramp off a bouncer from a spinner, I've seen it all! It's dug in short outside off, he sways away and nails the ramp over short third
Full and following the batter outside leg. Stoinis drives it out to long-off
And another one! Another slot ball dished out by Suyash and this time Shashank fetches it from outside off and whips it over deep square leg
Straight, high, and long! Takes on this slot ball and deposits it just behind the sight screen. Shashank with his second six of the over
On a length outside off, Stoinis looks to work it leg side and gets an inside edge onto his pads
Full and wide, he flat-bats it past the bowler down the ground
Full and wide, swept off the toe end to long-on
Shashank gets a hold of that one! Flat and full just outside off, right in the slot, and Shashank lifts it over long-on
On a length outside off, slowed down this time to 85kph. Worked down to long-on's right
Works this length ball down to long-on
Gets it in the gap. Reaches out for this full ball outside off and drives it off the outside half but it's just to backward point's right. Boundary after 18 balls
On a length outside off, he looks to swing it leg side. goes off the inside half to deep square leg
KP goes round-arm and Stoinis backs away to swing it to long-on's right
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler
KP with a vicious bouncer. Stoinis can only stand and watch it fly past him down leg. He'll have to bowl that again. Jitesh makes a good leaping save
Googly outside off spins in quite a bit and raps the pads as Shashank looks to defend. Impact looked outside off though
Short, wide and hit straight to long-off! This was a hit-me ball but Shedge doesn't hit it all too well. Gets it off the toe end, and flat to Virat Kohli, who accepts the gift with glee
Legbreak on a length outside off, punched down to long-off
Oh, he'll have to bowl that one again. Goes too wide, trying to take it away from Stoinis' arc. Legbreak spins away too much
Miscues this over cover. Looks to flat-bat this 99kph ball dragged down outside off. The ball balloons up and just clears the cover fielder running back
Drilled down the ground. Long-on gets around to cover
On a length outside off, pulled into the midwicket region. No fielder there so they get two without hassle
Speared in fuller, still at the pads to Shedge who is deep in the leg side. Driven down to long-on and Krunal's flown through this over in quick time
Goes back to a length on the pads, driven down to long-on
Goes for the blockhole, quite wide outside off. Confident drive down to deep cover now, though
On a length sliding into the pads again, flicked down to long leg this time
On a length but drifting into the pads, flicked down to deep midwicket
Starts off with a length ball, attacking the stumps. Driven down to deep extra cover
Driven down to covers, where a misfield bursts through the hands of Iyer and lets the batters sneak in a single
A cut now, down to deep cover. Bowler keeps it on a length outside off

Great timing, and it's only Virat Kohli that can save it from down there. Was on a length outside off, Shedge drove this as perfectly as he could, but Kohli runs in from deep extra cover and dives into the trajectory of the ball
Huge swipe across the line, and he's deposited this into the deep midwicket stand! Was on a length at the stumps. He gets down on one knee and middles this one by targeting the shorter side
On a length but spinning down leg, flicked down to deep square leg
On a length, attacking the off-stump line. Driven down to long-on and takes off for the other end
A laaaate glide down to deep backward point. Crouches low in the crease and lets this ball, on a length outside off, come right to him. Pierces the gap to perfection
Full-ish outside off, classy drive but straight to deep extra cover
Punched down to deep extra cover, where Bethell runs in to collect. Was back of a length outside off

Bethell gobbles this up at deep midwicket! Was a rather nonchalant flick across the line. Was on a length outside off, Connolly did not get the elevation he needed on this, and has to walk back with PBKS' mini-comeback aborted quickly
On a length outside off, driven down to deep extra cover once more
Back of a length and angled back in, towards Connolly. Pulled down to deep midwicket
Pushed just a little fuller, still on a fifth-stump line. Driven down to the covers
He keeps bowling long hops, and finally, he gets punished. Moving in from outside off and right in the swinging arc for Connolly, who swipes this into cow corner this time
Back of a length and a little too short, Shedge swipes this across the line and down to cow corner
Back of a length once more, Connolly keeps it grounded once more from outside off, swiped down to cow corner
Long hop, really, right on the wide line outside off. But batter is not in the mood for a big hit - just bunts this down to deep extra cover
89.2 kph first up, googly from leg-side and into the stumps. Flicked by the left-hander, towards midwicket
Speared in on a length, moving into the stumps. Flicked down to midwicket
Connolly has top edged this into the stands! An almost baseball swing on this one, flies over to deep fine leg... Was short and outside off. Modern T20 cricket etc etc...
Cramps him up on the stumps. On a length and batter can only flick it down to midwicket
Ooh, another waft across the line but rushes into his pads. Impact outside leg so the bowler aborts his appeal. Skidded into the batter and then down to backward point
Full and at the pads, and Connolly has timed this really well! Beats mid off, pinging off the bat with this grounded drive, and thuds into the ropes
Back of a length and angles back into Connolly's pads. He misses the flick
Smart cut, but a boundary cut off by Tim David sprinting in to deep point. Was on a length, well outside off. Gets the room to cut and Shedge does so, with smart hands
On a length but drifting down leg, Hazlewood has been disturbed off his regular lines in this over

Shedge is riding his luck in this over, and why not... Runs down the pitch, another bouncer heads his way. He plucks his body out of the way and just swings, wildly, at the ball. Lucky top edge and over the keeper's head, to the deep third boundary
Now he runs down the pitch and ducks at the bouncer sent his way! Adventurous batting in this over
Now he gets towards the off side to cover his stumps. Yorker dipping into his toes, he bunts this back to the bowler

Oof, where's this come out of? Was full-ish and in the slot, following Shedge into the leg side but he shuffles in even deeper, almost on the wide marker. Swipes across the line and sends it shuttling over the cow corner ropes...
Shedge is already deep in the leg side, Hazlewood follows him but misses the line. Wide down the pads and time to reload
French cut down to long leg. Was back of a length and the drive took the inside edge and dribbled behind the batter
Times the bones out of this one! Gets on top of the bounce, outside off, once more. Guides it with the middle of his bat, down to deep extra cover. Will give Shedge more confidence out in the middle
Jumps on top of this delivery. Back of a length and keeps low-ish. Defended out to mid-off
Why are the batters intent on these nothing wafts? Back of a length outside off, Shedge goes for another waft without much feet movement or connection, misses completely
Back of a length and moving into the batter. Driven back to the bowler

Whaddadelivery, and he's plucked out Shreyas with his second ball! What an Impact Sub this is. Hits a hard length, swings away from Shreyas as he looks to lazily dab this fine, late. Squared up because of the bounce, so close to his body. RCB on top here...
Another mistimed drive, hits the turf and dribbles to extra cover... Was on a length and outside off, rose at him more than he expected
Speared in fuller, closer to outside off. Driven down to long-off for an easy enough single

Huuuuge wicket, and Bhuvi is as animated as Kohli, which is saying something! Was a bit of a nothing ball, kept wayy outside off and drifting away even further. Prabhsimran throws his hands at this, lazily, and edges this like a bullet down to Padikkal in the slips. Punjab Kings in trouble...
Full-ish at the pads. Driven down to mid-on
On a length outside off, just a bit of width and he thrashes his hands at this. Hit down to deep point
Now he gets this outside off. Bunted late, down to backward point
Back of a length outside off, Prabhsimran happy to defend this into the ground
There's good comebacks, and then there's this. Outside off, angling back in and absolutely cutting Connolly's drive in half as it cramps him on the rise
Connolly shuffles into the off-side and picks this up like a spare note on the pavement! Was right in the slot outside off. Connolly swipes across the line and deposits over long-on
Driven to Kohli at point, where he shows a bit of panache as he throws it back. Was back of a length outside off
A confident cut, gets on top of it and down to deep point! Was back of a length outside off. Connolly jumps on top of the delivery and places it to perfection
On a length and angled into the batter from a leg-stump line. Can only tuck this straight to square leg
On a length outside off. Prabhsimran boshes a hefty drive but straight to deep point
Fuller and attacking the stumps. Driven down to mid-off, where the fielder collects. No chance of a run
Another Bhuvi beauty. An exhibition when he has the new ball, isn't it? On a length and outside off, shapes away with a huge arc away from the left-hander. Swishes at air
Romario, what have you done... Speared in quite full, at the stumps. Connolly drives this down to mid-on, where Shepherd lets an easy chance slip through his hands.

And Bhuvi's struck again! Back of a length, sticks in the pitch and rises at Arya, who goes for an ill-fated swipe across the line. Bottom edge down to midwicket, and he stares at his bat. But nothing doing with the disappointment, time to walk back for Arya
Back of a length and rising at the left-hander. Bunted down to covers but the cordon there is packed
Now he errs in his lines. Drifting down leg. Time to reload
Impeccable first up. He's just too good. On a tempting length just outside off, moves away from a tentative prod by Arya
